scripts.web:check: cd web && pnpm exec biome lint . && pnpm exec next typegen && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.worker:check: cd worker && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy pipeline
scripts.infra:check: cd infra && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate
